titulo_es: Distinguish an assessment of a data

Gästen verkar tveksam till förslaget.es: El invitado parece dudar de la propuesta
Gästen verkar tveksam till förslaget.en: The guest seems to doubt the proposal.

texto: Identify main idea, details and attitude in information texts read or heard. **Gästen verkar tveksam till förslaget** means «The guest seems to doubt the proposal.». It relates the expression to the purpose of the text. Look at the connectors and reformulate the idea with your own words before you respond. Sequence 3 of 3: incorporates this expression and reviews the above.
